steps.label: Fixed supply
steps.sub: Hard cap at genesis, never more

code:
Max supply     = hard ceiling (or "none" if uncapped)
Total supply   = everything minted so far
Circulating    = total minus locked/vesting/treasury

Example:
  Max supply:              1,000,000,000
  Total supply:               600,000,000
  Locked/vesting/treasury:    250,000,000
  Circulating supply:         350,000,000
caption: Market cap using total instead of circulating supply overstates liquidity.

code:
net_supply_change = emissions_minted - tokens_burned

One year:
  Staking emissions:      20,000,000 tokens minted
  Transaction-fee burns:  25,000,000 tokens burned

net_supply_change = 20,000,000 - 25,000,000 = -5,000,000
caption: Circulating supply shrinks by 5M even while the protocol keeps minting rewards.
The supply model is a deliberate design choice, not an afterthought.
